verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API covers Spend & Expense and says developers can "Manage transactions & reimbursements," so an agent could plausibly pull S&E transactions via REST. Nothing documents filtering for uncoded transactions, writing categories or coding back, or a review step. The only MCP server serves API documentation, not transaction data, and BILL's own AI categorization is an internal product feature rather than an agent-facing write path. Missing for 10: documented endpoints to list uncoded transactions, an API to write categorizations and policy flags back, a review/approval queue for agent-proposed coding, MCP access to transaction data, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review

citations.quote: Build with card & expense management services. Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards. Manage transactions & reimbursements.
Use the BILL v3 API & access the full breadth of the BILL API Platform: AP, AR, & S&E.
